title: Only one target is requested when playing Defiant Dance
expected: Parser drops "another": in packages/riftbound-cards/src/parser/impl/effects-might.ts:144 the compound regex consumes `another` in a non-capturing group `(?:another\s+)?` before capture group 5, so parseTarget(compoundMatch[5]) (line 173) gets bare "unit" and never sets excludeSelf. Verified by running parseAbilities on the card text: sequence of two modify-might effects both with target {type:"unit"} (identical). The engine's collectSequenceTargetSlots (packages/riftbound-engine/src/game-definition/moves/play/targeting.ts:165) then treats the second identical descriptor as a restatement of the first and merges them into ONE slot, so findSequenceLeadTarget returns a single lead target and the playSpell enumerator (play-spell.ts:748-785) emits single-target variants only; the sequence handler threads that one bound target to both steps. Hence one-target prompt, offered with exactly one unit on board.
observed: availableMoves lists playSpell variants with a single-element targets array only (one per unit); UI banner 'Choose a target for Defiant Dance' closes after one click and the spell is immediately put on the chain with 1 target. With zero units on board the spell is not offered at all, with exactly one unit it is offered (should need two distinct units).
